text: Draw the prompt flow as mermaid.

Here's how a prompt flows:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  U[User] --> C[Composer]
  C --> D{pocketd}
  D -->|stream| T[Transcript]
  D -->|tools| R[Repo]
```

And the turn, step by step:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant App
  participant Daemon
  participant Claude
  App->>Daemon: send prompt
  Daemon->>Claude: start turn
  Claude-->>Daemon: text + tool calls
  Daemon-->>App: timeline items
```

A broken one shows its error:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A -->
```

A wide one fits the card's width:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Prompt typed] --> B[Draft saved] --> C[Sent to pocketd] --> D[Claude starts] --> E[Tools run] --> F[Text streams] --> G[Turn ends] --> H[Result shown]
```

Done.
